description: This file defines the interface 'GenericHelper' which provides various methods for managing entity objects within the Apache OFBiz framework, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and validation of entity data.

classes.name: GenericHelper
classes.description: An interface defining helper methods for managing generic entity operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the name of the server configuration associated with this helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database from a GenericValue object.

methods.name: createAll
methods.description: Creates multiple entities in the database from a list of GenericValue objects.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial set of fields of a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Finds multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Deletes an entity identified by its primary key.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching specific conditions, returning an iterator that must be closed after use.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Updates entities matching a condition with specified field values.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores (updates) an entity in the database.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Validates the data source schema and optionally adds missing entities or fields.
